title: Ringed-topos morphism with independent site universes
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D$ be sites with object universes $c,d$, morphism universes $v,w$, and Grothendieck topologies $J,K$, each essentially small in a coefficient universe $r$. Let $A$ and $B$ be sheaves of rings in universe $r$ on these sites. Define a ringed-topos morphism from $(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C),A)$ to $(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D),B)$ by the same data as [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism], with these independent universes: an adjunction $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ on sheaves of sets in universe $r$, finite-limit preservation by $f^{-1}$, a structural map $f^{-1}B\to A$ preserving $0,1,+,\cdot$ on all generalized elements, and an additive direct image of module sheaves naturally identified on underlying sheaves with $f_*$. Its scalar action is induced by the structural map: the adjoint transpose of $ax+y$ is $f^\sharp(f^{-1}a)\widetilde x+\widetilde y$. No equality between the site object, morphism, and coefficient universes is required.
